symbols.name: frame at a vertex
symbols.meaning: The frame at vertex $v$, an invertible linear operator on the space of arrays indexed by the common address set.
symbols.quote: Let $D_v$ denote the frame at a source, gate or sink $v$: an invertible linear operator on the space of arrays indexed by the common address set.

symbols.name: input role
symbols.meaning: An input role of the network, whose array is routed to an output role.
symbols.quote: On a route from an input role $w$ to the output role $\rho(w)$ assigned to it, the intermediate frames cancel along the path, leaving the operator $D_{\mathrm{sink}(\rho(w))}D_{\mathrm{source}(w)}^{-1}$, where $\mathrm{source}(w)$ and $\mathrm{sink}(\rho(w))$ are the vertices at which the route starts and ends, times its prescribed scalar sign.

symbols.name: output role map
symbols.meaning: The map sending each input role to the output role it is routed to.
symbols.quote: On a route from an input role $w$ to the output role $\rho(w)$ assigned to it, the intermediate frames cancel along the path, leaving the operator $D_{\mathrm{sink}(\rho(w))}D_{\mathrm{source}(w)}^{-1}$, where $\mathrm{source}(w)$ and $\mathrm{sink}(\rho(w))$ are the vertices at which the route starts and ends, times its prescribed scalar sign.

relations.quote: Each frame acts on the wires of a [Linear network that restores auxiliary values](linear-network.md).
